newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish crown weakens on Asbrink EMU remarks.
newsitem.headline: Swedish crown weakens on Asbrink EMU remarks.

text.p: The Swedish crown softened on Monday after a Swedish news agency reported Finance Minister Erik Asbrink had raised the spectre of devaluation.

But Asbrink's comments in Luxembourg, where he was reviewing why Sweden decided not to join the EU's economic and monetary union, were referring to mechanisms available to countries outside EMU to control monetary policy.
Asked if he was discussing devaluation, Asbrink told a news conference there: "Yes, you could say that. But you can equally discuss revaluation."
But markets were confused by the report, which only mentioned devaluation initially. The crown was marked down to 4.5110 to the mark vs 4.4910 late on Friday
"Apparently Asbrink said that they did not want to link the crown to ERM because they wanted to be able to let the crown go if needed," a trader said.
